The presidency's real archived English tree is sandorpalota.hu/en (Novák Katalin 2022-2024, Sulyok Tamás 2024- ). TITLE(h1)/TEXT(.node__content)/DATE(span.post-created) green on ALL 8 samples; bodies 535-18,993 chars (the longest an English interview with President Sulyok in a German paper; also 'Presidential opening address at the Winemaker of the Winemakers Awards Gala', Novák in New York). Genuine English, no MT needed. THE KEY LINK_PATTERN EXCLUSION is /en/node/<id>: Drupal serves every article at BOTH a slug URL and a canonical node URL, so without the exclusion every article would be scraped twice; /en/media/oembed YouTube endpoints and /en/node?page=N paginators are dropped too. That filtering is why 2,470 raw becomes 693. Like the live recipe this is the presidency's whole English feed - news, statements and speeches together - so the cleaner's document_type gate does the separating and the 693 is an upper bound on rows, not speeches. NO speaker_default (two presidents). FULL RUN is the researcher's gate.
